Research shows that women and other under-represented groups within our industry hesitate to apply unless they tick most boxes of a role description. At Stegra, we are building an impact company with sustainability at its core. We need a diverse, inclusive, and authentic team to rally behind our purpose of de-carbonizing hard-to-abate industries, starting with steel.So, if you are equally passionate about our purpose yet concerned that your experience doesn’t perfectly align with the qualifications stated in the job advert, we strongly encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate, either for this role – or for another upcoming role in our rapidly growing business.About us:Stegra is on a mission to disrupt the global steel industry by producing green steel, with the end goal of bringing down CO2 emissions to zero. By using green hydrogen and fossil-free electricity instead of coal; water and heat will be our primary emissions. By 2030, our ambition is to produce 5 million tonnes of green steel annually in our fully integrated, digitalized, and sustainable plant in Boden, located in northern Sweden - currently in construction phase. But this is just the beginning – our expertise in green hydrogen will enable us to decarbonize other industries in addition to steel, and we look forward to what’s next in store for us.We are looking for talented, innovative, and purpose-driven people to join our rapidly growing and diverse team. Our employees get to learn everyday, implement the latest technology and test and put their ideas into practice. Together, we are building an impact company with sustainability at its core – for our people, customers, investors, society, and planet.Work location: BodenWhat you’ll doRight now, we are looking for a Project Engineer for our Project Delivery team. In this role you will work closely with our Groundworks Manager, Construction teams, EPCM Area Leads, planners, and contractors to support the delivery of civil and early works across the Boden project.As Project Engineer, you will help turn engineering packages into construction-ready scopes. You will coordinate documentation, interfaces, and execution requirements to ensure workfronts are properly prepared before being released to contractors. This is a hands-on role suited to someone who enjoys working close to both engineering and site execution.Specific to this role, the day-to-day tasks will include the following but as we are a growing company with very little silos between teams, other tasks might be included as well.    Coordinate preparation and release of groundworks scopes, ensuring drawings, quantities, and execution requirements are ready for construction    Maintain the Groundworks Scope Tracker and consolidate inputs from EPCM partners, design teams, and planners    Support forecasting and planning of upcoming groundworks activities    Coordinate scope clarifications between Engineering, Planning, Construction, and contractors    Support and maintain a structured RFI process between contractors and engineering stakeholders    Help align groundworks activities with project schedules, civil milestones, and interface dependencies    Participate in coordination meetings and support progress reporting and issue resolution    Monitor contractor readiness, access conditions, and documentation prior to site executionWhat you’ll bringYou’re curious and believe that real progress happens when we work together. You’re not afraid to challenge old ways of thinking and you treat others with respect while doing it. At Stegra, we value people who take initiative, build trust, and help create a workplace where everyone can do their best.This role is well suited to someone who has built a solid foundation in civil engineering or construction and wants to continue developing in a large-scale industrial project environment.Specific to this role, we would like to see that you can tick off a fair amount of the boxes below    Degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a related technical field    Around 3–7 years of experience from large-scale industrial, construction, or infrastructure projects    Good understanding of civil construction, design documentation, and site execution    Experience working in EPCM, contractor, or major project environments is considered an advantage    Strong coordination skills and the ability to work across multiple teams and disciplines    Familiarity with Primavera P6 or similar planning tools is considered an advantage    Experience with Swedish AMA/AB04 standards is considered a plus    Fluency in English; Swedish is considered an advantage

jobs.occupation: Software Engineer - Machine Learning or Computer Vision
jobs.description: Volumental is the footwear industry’s leading FitTech™ company, using 3D scanning and machine learning to match people with shoes that truly fit.Our vision is “a world without sizes, where every body fits.” We work with brands such as New Balance, Red Wing, Fleet Feet, and Vivobarefoot across 3,000+ stores in 60 countries, with 60M+ foot scans collected, one of the world’s largest datasets of its kind.Computer vision, machine learning, and AI have always been at the core of our product. Today, we also use AI agents as everyday companions in our work, helping us shorten feedback cycles, deepen our expertise, and explore new areas. We believe the best work comes from people who never stop learning and who care deeply about their craft.Our Products and TeamsWe target businesses and stores selling footwear such as shoes, ski boots and hockey skates, as well as insoles. We develop two related products, each with its own team:    In-store product. We sell a 3D scanner that our business customers put in their physical retail stores and use to scan shoppers' feet. The scanner is controlled by a tablet, which shows the 3D scans and recommends footwear from the store's range.    Online product. We sell 3D scanning and recommendation web components that our business customers integrate into their online store. It allows online shoppers to scan their own feet using their own phone and get size recommendations for the footwear in that online store.We are also exploring new product opportunities, such as 3D scanning beyond feet and footwear. You will start in our Online product team, with the chance to move into other teams over time. Whichever team you are in, you will be part of shaping our current and future products. Algorithm Development at VolumentalBoth of our products are built on top of two core algorithmic systems:    3D foot scanning system. It takes images of a person's feet and reconstructs a 3D model. This involves areas such as camera calibration, image processing, image classification, image segmentation, object detection, parametric 3D models, numerical optimization and machine learning.    Footwear recommendation system. This is based on machine learning and our ever-growing dataset of more than 30 million samples of 3D scans matched with footwear purchases. Given a shopper's unique pair of feet, we predict and recommend what footwear will fit them. This involves areas such as machine learning, probabilistic methods, model fitting, numerical optimization, training, inference, ranking, statistics, data visualization, data cleaning and outlier detection.For both systems, we put a strong emphasis on empirical evaluation and optimization, based on data that we continuously gather from our users. We want to measure what works and what does not (yet) work in practice, and find ways to improve it.You will have the chance to work on either of these systems, depending partly on your previous experience and interests and partly on the current needs of our products and users.Our algorithmic tech stack includes technologies like: Python, C++, Go, SQL, NumPy, SciPy, Pandas, Polars, TensorFlow, Keras, JAX, Eigen, Ceres, OpenCV, Google Cloud Platform, BigQuery, Devin AI, Greptile, Claude… You will influence which tools we use, and if you find something better, we want to hear about it. We offer premium AI agent subscriptions and encourage everyone to explore, test, and share useful ways of working with AI. We are excited about you because you:    Have experience in both mathematical modeling and programming.    Are a collaborative and kind team member.    Can solve difficult problems in practice.    Have experience working with datasets and evaluating different methods.    Have a master's degree in computer science, engineering physics, electrical engineering, or similar.It is a plus if you:    Have professional experience of software engineering.    Have professional experience working with algorithms in areas like:    Machine learning    Computer vision    Computer graphics    Image processing    Robotics    Numerical optimization What we can offer you:    Personal learning budget and access to coaching    Opportunity to work with a great team of 15+ nationalities in our English-speaking office    Occupational pension at ITP1 level    Flexible Public Holidays Policy    Options Program    Parental pay top-up    Wellness allowance    Flexible work policy (at least 3 days a week from our Stockholm office) The monthly compensation range for this role in Stockholm is 50,000-77,000 SEK. Actual compensation will depend on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process.We are hiring for multiple positions and welcome both junior and senior engineers from all backgrounds. We’d love to hear from you!

Boliden is a high-tech metals company with its own mines and smelters that works long-term to guarantee society's access to base and precious metals. At Boliden, we know that the metals we mine and make available will continue to play a crucial role in the future – what matters is how we produce them. Become a part of us and drive change for generations to come.  Do you want to secure critical industrial operations where cyber security directly impacts safety, production, and sustainability?As a Cyber Security Engineer at Boliden, you will design and implement robust security solutions, reduce vulnerabilities, and safeguard both IT and OT environments. You will help ensure that production-critical systems are resilient, reliable, and built for the future.We look forward to receiving your application!Your opportunityIn this role, you will lead engineering- and architecture-driven risk reduction across complex IT and OT environments, with ownership of the vulnerability management capability and its evolution across tools, processes, and architecture.You will translate threat and vulnerability insights into architectural patterns, hardening strategies, and risk-based remediation roadmaps. Identify, assess, and manage vulnerabilities across IT and OT environments, driving risk-based and sustainable remediation.    Define and guide secure architectures, standards, and security-by-design principles across solutions and projects.    Provide hands-on technical support and act as a trusted advisor in security design, configuration, and issue resolution.    Lead and coordinate patching and remediation efforts, ensuring compliance and reducing long-term risk exposure.    Track, report, and improve security posture through KPIs, risk insights, and continuous maturity development.What you bring    Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate across IT, OT, and business functions.    Strong engineering mindset, with the ability to design scalable, secure, and practical solutions.    Solid understanding of IT/OT architectures, security controls, and modern attack methodologies.    Ability to translate risk into clear technical decisions and architectural improvements.    Analytical and solution-oriented, with a structured approach and strong problem-solving capability.    Continuous learning mindset, with a proactive approach to emerging threats and technologies    Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience.    Fluent English, both written and spoken; Swedish, Finnish, Norwegian, or Portuguese is an advantage.    A valid EU Category B driving licence, as the role involves regular travel to our sites.Why work with usAt Boliden, we believe in promoting a workplace where care, courage, and responsibility are central to everything we do. We offer a workplace where we believe in collaboration and where what you contribute will have a direct impact on future generations. We are a company made up of responsible and creative people all working towards the same vision; to become the most sustainable and respected metal supplier in the world.Apply today to be part of something truly meaningful!At Boliden, diversity and inclusion are drivers of innovation. We know that different perspectives and experiences strengthen us and help us stay at the forefront of an important and exciting industry. Therefore, we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and viewpoints. Together, we build a workplace where everyone can feel safe and inspired to reach their full potential.Want to know more about the position? Company description:Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. Withcutting-edge technology, Epiroc develops and produces innovative drill rigs, rock excavation and constructionequipment, and provides world-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm,Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countries.Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.Job description:We’re looking for a Product Owner – AI & Test Engineering to join our SW Platform organization. We’re responsible for the machine platform that Epiroc’s mining and construction equipment runs on. In this role, AI is at the heart of what you do. You’ll help shape how software developers across all of Epiroc use AI in their daily work, and how AI changes the way we test and verify our software. Are you curious about how AI is changing software development? Do you enjoy collaborating with people across teams and helping turn needs into clear priorities? Would you like to help build something new from the start, with an impact across the whole company? Then we’d love to hear from you. A stream in the making AI & Test Engineering is a new product stream in our platform organisation. The teams are being built right now, and their setup, size and exact scope aren’t finalised yet. As Product Owner, you’ll have a real opportunity to influence how the stream takes shape, together with the teams, your manager and the Chief Product Owner. Your mission As Product Owner you’re responsible for the AI & Test Engineering product stream, where AI is the main focus. The stream is planned to cover two areas:      AI Software Factory: exploring and introducing AI-supported, agentic ways of working across the software development lifecycle, for all software developers at Epiroc.     AI-driven Test & Integration: using AI to rethink how we test and integrate platform software, together with test frameworks, simulation, a software-defined lab and system testing.  You connect the teams with their stakeholders. For the AI Software Factory, these are software developers and development teams across Epiroc’s divisions and sites. For Test & Integration, they are mainly the internal teams that develop and deliver on the platform. You’re responsible for the product backlog in Jira and the roadmap. By listening to stakeholders and understanding their needs, you help translate them into clear epics and user stories and support the teams in focusing on what creates the most value. You keep up with how AI in software development is evolving and help turn new possibilities into practical value for developers and testers. You work closely with the Scrum Masters and Tech Leads, collaborate with our architects and work closely with the Chief Product Owner on the overall platform roadmap. You also take part in cross-team planning together with the other product streams. You’ll report to a team manager in the SW Platform organization and be part of a supportive team where knowledge sharing and learning are encouraged.Profile description:Your profile      You have experience as a Product Owner or in a similar role, for example product manager, test lead, technical project lead or requirements owner, in a software development environment.     You have a genuine interest in AI and how it can support software development and testing, and you may already use AI tools in your own work.     You’re familiar with agile ways of working such as Scrum and with tools like Jira.     You enjoy working with a broad range of stakeholders and helping new ways of working spread across an organization.     It’s a plus if you have experience with AI-assisted or agentic software development, AI in testing, test automation, CI/CD or simulation.     You speak Swedish and you’re fluent in English, both written and spoken.  As a person, you’re curious, structured, communicative and collaborative. You’re comfortable when not everything is decided yet, and you enjoy helping to create structure together with others. You build trusting relationships with stakeholders, help the teams find focus and like to keep learning. We know that great candidates don’t always meet every requirement. If this role sounds interesting, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t tick every box. We welcome applicants of all genders and backgrounds and believe diverse teams build better products. Location The role is based in Örebro, Sweden. We work hybrid, with at least three days a week in the office. Application and contacts Please send your application, including CV and personal letter, by creating an account in our recruitment system as soon as possible but no later than 27th of November. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and the position may be filled before last application date. Please note that, due to the current regulations, we will only consider applications received through our system and not via email or social media.
